name: launchpad
description: Fair-launch HTS tokens on a bonding curve and graduate them into a SaucerSwap V1 pool with permanently locked liquidity. Foundry + Next.js, HCS comment threads, mirror-node charts.

steps.text: The frontend is pre-wired to a live Launchpad on Hedera testnet, so you can start trading right away. Deploy your own when you are ready.

steps.label: Start the app (uses the shared testnet deployment)
Get testnet HBAR for your wallet
Run the contract tests (offline, HTS emulated)
Create a deployer keystore and fund it
Deploy your Launchpad, wired to SaucerSwap
Walk the full lifecycle on testnet and print HashScan links

steps.text: Optional: enable HCS comment threads with `{run:next:hcs:create-topic}` — see README → Comments.
